selected_cases.name: filter-failed-create-recipient
selected_cases.requirement: A failed top-level CREATE has no created-address match.

selected_cases.name: filter-failed-nested-create-recipient
selected_cases.requirement: A failed nested CREATE has no created-address match.

selected_cases.name: filter-failed-create-creator
selected_cases.requirement: A failed CREATE still matches its creator.

selected_cases.name: filter-failed-nested-create-creator
selected_cases.requirement: A failed nested CREATE matches its creating contract.

selected_cases.name: filter-failed-create-union
selected_cases.requirement: Union mode retains the creator match of a failed CREATE.

selected_cases.name: filter-failed-create-intersection
selected_cases.requirement: A failed CREATE has no recipient side, so an intersection with its would-be address is empty.

selected_cases.name: filter-destroyed-recipient
selected_cases.requirement: A created-then-destroyed address matches its creation and its SELFDESTRUCT beneficiary.

selected_cases.name: filter-self-destruct-from
selected_cases.requirement: A SELFDESTRUCT matches fromAddress by its executing account.

selected_cases.name: filter-self-destruct-to
selected_cases.requirement: A SELFDESTRUCT to self also matches toAddress as its own beneficiary.
